_comment: Per-1,000,000-token prices in USD, used by backend/costs.py.
Only gpt-6-luna is priced, because it is the only model this project may bill.
Keeping the pinned model and the priced model the same file means a cost figure and
the model actually charged cannot drift apart.
Filled in 2026-11-11 from the course's own published figures (MGT 409 Lecture 11,
'Cached Token Cost'), and corroborated against the independent copy in this
workspace's HW6 data pack, which was taken from the same slide. Two sources, same
KNOWN UNDERSTATEMENT. The course also publishes a cache-write price of $0.125/1M —
the surcharge on the FIRST call that writes a prompt prefix into the cache, at 1.25x
the input rate. It is recorded below but estimate_cost does not model it, because
the provider does not report cache writes separately in the usage object. Our cost
figures are therefore slightly LOW on a cold cache and correct once warm. Say so in
report.html rather than presenting the number as exact.

gpt-6-luna._cache_write_note: Recorded for the report; not applied by estimate_cost. See the comment above.
